headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: PAT attributable to owners was INR 2,758 crore (+22.9%), with growth at 22% after adjusting for MTM.
Unlike Q1, the headline growth was not flattered by MTM, as both insurers booked unrealized losses on equity.
Bajaj Finance (BFL): PAT rose 28.5% to INR 6,267 crore, and net total income grew 23.0% to INR 15,974 crore.
PAT growth before the INR 337 crore prudent management and macro-economic provision was 33.8%.
valuation: Management Guidance for the Future • Breakeven & Capital Plan: Bajaj Markets targets quarterly breakeven in Q4 FY27, Bajaj Health in FY28, and Bajaj AMC in FY29 (at INR 90,000–1,00,000 cr AUM).
